acceptance.given: The existing S7 candidate-identity fixture is prepared or interpreted by the replay workflow.

oracle.expected: The candidate-identity fixture is consumed only for its declared S7 fixture role; executed S7 assertions establish behavior and the fixture path itself is never treated as proof.
forbidden: The fixture's file existence is treated as proof of S7 behavior.
The fixture is used outside its declared role.
oracle.observable: The executed S7 test records the fixture role and independently reports behavior assertions.

acceptance.then: The role-limited fixture check passes and no behavior verdict is derived from file existence.
acceptance.when: When preparing or interpreting S7 fixtures.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the S7 fixture-role assertion against a run that consumes candidate-identity.v1.json outside its declared fixture role.
Execute the S7 evidence assertion with the fixture present but without executed behavior assertions, and reject any behavior verdict based solely on file existence.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; restore prior fixture-role handling.

slice_hint.state_transition: Fixture loaded for declared S7 role -> S7 behavior verdict produced only from executed assertions.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result is reported as successful by the replay workflow.

oracle.expected: That successful Replay Result contains its own independently executed snapshot-verification outcome, bound to the same target, validator, dependencies, command, Probe, output, Consumer, and non-authority context.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result whose snapshot verification is only inferred from another verification.
A success verdict without an independently observed snapshot check.
oracle.observable: Per-result evidence contains a distinct snapshot-verification assertion and result for every successful Replay Result.

acceptance.then: Each successful Replay Result has an independent snapshot-verification outcome.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the S7 replay success selector with a successful Replay Result whose snapshot verification is omitted or copied only from another result.
Execute the S7 replay success selector with snapshot evidence bound to a different target, command, Probe, output, Consumer, or authority context.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require an independently executed snapshot-verification assertion for every successful Replay Result, preserving all result-determining bindings.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; restore prior replay-result evaluation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Replay Result success candidate -> independent snapshot verification -> success accepted only with matching bindings.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every successful Replay Result has a distinct passing snapshot-verification observation bound to its own execution context.

acceptance.given: The success-evaluation process encounters a case marked unexecuted.

oracle.expected: The case receives a non-success outcome, and the evaluator emits evidence identifying the unexecuted state as the reason success was rejected.
forbidden: The unexecuted case is reported as successful.
A success verdict is inferred from planned, skipped, or absent execution.
oracle.observable: The executed evaluator result for the unexecuted case is a rejected/non-success verdict with an explicit unexecuted-case marker.

acceptance.then: Success is rejected for the unexecuted case.
acceptance.when: When an unexecuted case is encountered.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the S7 success-evaluation selector with an unexecuted case and assert that it must not produce a successful verdict.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure the success evaluator rejects unexecuted cases and records the explicit non-success reason.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; restore prior success-evaluation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Case encountered as unexecuted -> evaluator emits non-success verdict with unexecuted marker.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Any unexecuted case deterministically yields a non-success outcome.

acceptance.given: The compiler has a per-obligation slice hint with real repository-relative production-owner paths and frozen execution snapshot paths.

oracle.expected: For this obligation, every production_owner is outside execution_snapshot_paths and is included in allowed_write_paths.
forbidden: A production owner omitted from allowed_write_paths.
oracle.observable: The compiled per-obligation slice hint is checked for path-set intersection and write-boundary membership.

acceptance.then: The compiler accepts only a hint whose production ownership boundary is separate from its frozen test snapshots.
acceptance.when: During V3 contract normalization before slice compilation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the explicit-path contract test with a hint that places its production owner in execution_snapshot_paths; it must reject the overlap.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce the structural boundary that compiler-owned production paths are writable owners but cannot be frozen test-snapshot selectors.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema or state changes; reverting restores the prior compiler boundary check.

slice_hint.state_transition: A structurally ambiguous owner/snapshot hint becomes a compiler-validated role-separated hint.
